difficulty_reason: The authors construct invariant-guided infinite narrowing simulations of nonterminating rewriting. For right-linear systems this requires variable-disjoint most-general unification, linear-substitution control and a lifted step simulation; for locally confluent overlay systems it uses minimal nontermination, innermost rewriting and the Gramlich switch. Complete current linear-unification/narrowing/innermost support and both RFC proofs remain here. These non-routine constructions support H2 as one combined termination-equivalence theorem.
core_obligations: Retain wf_trs, infinite variable/renaming setup and the alternative right-linear or locally-confluent-overlay conditions.
Retain the complete current author RFC proof and all four supporting theories; no generated proof or changed assumptions.
Keep native sources with original BSD license and author conference-to-formal statement mapping; do not claim an Isabelle run.
